summary: Scalar-deleting destructor for the object whose vtable is off_5AAFD0. Writes the vtable into this[0], runs the common InitWithVTableCleanup teardown, then frees this when the a2 bit 0 (scalar-deletion) flag is set.

operations.description: Set this[0] to &off_5AAFD0, installing the object vtable.
Invoke common cleanup/teardown dispatcher InitWithVTableCleanup on this.
When (a2 & 1) != 0, the scalar-deleting flag is set.
Free this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the scalar-deleting flag is set.
